create_kimi_vl_config: create a KimiVLConfig instance with default vision and text configs for multimodal model initialization
create_kimi_vl_config_with_vision: create a KimiVLConfig instance passing a dict for vision_config to customize MoonViT parameters
create_kimi_vl_config_with_text: create a KimiVLConfig instance passing a dict for text_config to customize DeepseekV2 language model parameters
create_kimi_vl_config_with_ids: create a KimiVLConfig instance with custom ignore_index, media_placeholder_token_id, and pad_token_id values
create_kimi_vl_config_with_objects: create a KimiVLConfig instance passing MoonViTConfig and DeepseekV2Config objects directly instead of dicts
